nodes.text: DIMENSIONS | Width/height in cm; two sliding leaves span the aperture. X wall normal, Y aperture width. Safety box is wider than the collision plane.
POSE | Smooth horizontal double opening. Collision stays enabled. Doorway occupancy is checked before every closing step. Prompts are visible from both sides.
WAKE | Reset real-time delta before movement. Tick runs only during animation or transient feedback.
TARGET | Set desired open state. Runtime scripts may call this after changing bLocked; story permissions remain outside the door.
FEEDBACK | Runtime text, shown for two real seconds. LOCKED or DOORWAY BLOCKED. No debug-only PrintString.
SAFETY | Uses the pawn overlap of the sill box; null/unpossessed pawn safely returns false in native IsOverlappingActor.
OMEN AUTO | Near-player check at 10 Hz. Opens both leaves; waits until the player leaves before closing. Lock state remains instance-editable.
CONSTRUCTION | Size the door from instance parameters. Actor transform sets placement/orientation; keep scale at one.
BEGIN PLAY | Preserve existing parent setup, configure dimensions, initialise motion and automatic polling.
AUTOMATIC DOOR | Overlap enter/leave immediately reevaluate proximity. Timer also notices lock changes.
F INTERACTION | Existing interface only. Locked -> feedback. Open -> check sill. Clear -> toggle.
MOTION AND SAFETY | Bounded real delta, reverse a closing leaf if occupied, sleep when settled and message expired.
